items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Smoked duck' to USDA FNDDS 'Duck, cooked, skin eaten'. The target is explicitly duck and its own pinned evidence contains this exact cooked-duck record. Smoking is a cooking/preservation treatment and does not change the underlying species identity. Confidence remains medium because the USDA record is generically cooked rather than smoked and includes skin, so smoke curing, sodium, moisture loss, and exact cut are not represented; this review does not generalize to duck sauce, duck egg, or non-duck smoked foods.

Confidence remains medium because the target does not specify pepper color, boiling versus another cooking method, draining, or added salt; this review does not generalize to hot peppers or pepper sauces.

Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Fermented cucumber brine' to USDA SR Legacy 'Pickles, cucumber, sour'. Fermented cucumber brine is the liquid phase of sour fermented/pickled cucumbers, and the target's own pinned evidence contains this exact sour-cucumber-pickle record. Confidence remains medium because brine differs from whole pickles in vegetable solids, fibre, sodium, acidity, and water distribution; this is a same-food fermentation proxy and does not generalize to raw cucumber or unrelated pickle brines.

Confidence remains medium because the USDA record does not preserve yuzu species, pulp level, concentration, or finishing quantity; this review does not generalize to sweetened fruit-juice drinks, orange juice specifically, or non-fruit juices.
